ome_tiff_write — FILEIO ome_tiff op

• Data kinds: any → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ome_tiff_write(stack, *, meta) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.ome_tiff_write(stack, *, meta); from the registry, opsfileio.get("ome_tiff_write"))

Usage

Write a TCZYX multidimensional array with physical sizes and channel names as OME-TIFF bytes.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

meta['axes'] は TCZYX の部分列で YX 終端。X/Y(および Z 軸があれば Z)の physical_size_* と *_unit、C 軸があれば channel_names を必須とする。

呼び出し例: ome_tiff_write(stack, meta={"axes": "CZYX", ...})。
